keySource: The key is NYSED's own, read from the Map to the Standards in the released-items PDF and carried into provenance/itemmap_g7-2024.json by tools/extract_item_map.py. tools/merge_content.py re-checks every letter against that file item by item and refuses to build if one disagrees, so the key here cannot drift from the official table or be shifted by one released item. Every constructed-response answer below cites NYSED's own exemplary-response page and is checked against this project's transcription of the same item.

39.source: NYSED exemplary response, scoring materials page 7 (PDF page 8)
39.check: 25 words a minute over t minutes is 25t words. The rate is in this item's own transcribed stem.

40.source: NYSED exemplary response, scoring materials page 12 (PDF page 13)
40.check: Minus 2 times minus 3 is 6, times 4 is 24. The expression is this item's own transcribed stem.

41.source: NYSED exemplary response, scoring materials page 17 (PDF page 18)
41.check: 55 minus 38.50 is 16.50, and 16.50 over 55 is 0.30. Both prices are in this item's own transcribed stem.

42.source: NYSED exemplary response, scoring materials page 22 (PDF page 23)
42.check: The first three spins total minus 3, so the last two must total 3. Every value on the spinner is in this item's figure and named in its long description.

43.source: NYSED exemplary response, scoring materials page 32 (PDF page 33)
43.check: Five and a half miles over two and a fifth hours is 5.5 over 2.2, which is 2.5. Both quantities are in this item's own transcribed stem.

44.source: NYSED exemplary response, scoring materials page 42 (PDF page 43)
44.check: 225 miles at 50 miles to the centimetre is 4.5 centimetres. The scale and the distance are in this item's own stem.

45.source: NYSED exemplary response, scoring materials page 52 (PDF page 53)
45.check: 25 turkey at 4.99 is 124.75, and 219.56 minus that is 94.81, which is 19 more sandwiches. All three figures are in this item's own stem.

46.source: NYSED exemplary response, scoring materials page 62 (PDF page 63)
46.check: Minus 8 times 4 minus x is minus 32 plus 8x, and plus 20 gives minus 12 plus 8x. The expression is this item's own transcribed stem.

47.source: NYSED exemplary response, scoring materials page 72 (PDF page 73)
47.check: A third for the comedy, a third for the chips and a half for the juice multiply to one eighteenth. All three option lists are in this item's own stem.

48.source: NYSED exemplary response, scoring materials page 82 (PDF page 83)
48.check: 460 discounted by 20% implies an original 575; with 8% tax that is 621 against 496.80. Both the discounted price and the tax rate are in this item's own stem.
